results.reason: precious = valuable (귀중한). ordinary는 반의어, temporary/artificial 무관.
spontaneous = impromptu (즉흥적인). deliberate는 반의어, frequent/expensive 무관.
affordable = reasonable (적당한 가격의). 본문 'reasonable price' 단서.
unique 반의어 = common (흔한). special/unusual은 동의어 방향.
thankful = grateful (감사하는). reluctant/doubtful/regretful 부적합.
to ______ our travel memories = preserve. purchase/replace/abandon 부적합.
had ______ lots of maps = accumulated. forgotten/purchased/stored 맥락 부적합.
a ______ tradition = lifelong. temporary/forgotten/ordinary 반대.
Without a moment's ______ = hesitation (관용구).
a ______ connection = reliable. challenging 이미 사용, temporary/reasonable 부적합.
catching a ______ of = glimpse (관용구). photograph/collection/memory 부적합.
color your soul and ______ your life = enrich. preserve/store/remind 부적합.
wouldn't ______ or wear out = fade. last/store/hang 문맥 부적합.
I ______ an elderly couple = made friends with. 다른 선지 문맥 부적합.
we ______ mainly on paper maps = relied. stored/purchased/accumulated + on 부적합.
to keep something = preserve. purchase=구매, decorate=장식, abandon=버리다.
a thing you buy to remind yourself = souvenir.
not planned but done suddenly = spontaneous.
something that makes you remember = reminder.
to improve quality by adding to it = enrich.
